title: A little code. A good place to start.
intro: Start with Node.js 22 or newer. Install Qbits, create a component, and connect it to Vite.

sections.title: 01 — Install Qbits
sections.body: In an existing npm project, install the published package. Add Vite as a development dependency if your project does not already use it.
sections.code:
npm install qbits
npm install --save-dev vite

sections.title: 02 — Write your first .qb component
sections.body: Create src/App.qb. Declare state before the interface. Text expressions are safe text nodes, and numeric values use str() when combined with a string.
sections.code:
component App:
    count = 0
    button text="Count: " + str(count):
        on click:
            count = count + 1

sections.title: 03 — Connect the compiler
sections.body: Create vite.config.js using the published plugin. Your index.html should contain a root element and load src/main.js as a module.

sections.title: 04 — Mount your interface
sections.body: In src/main.js, import the component and the matching runtime. The mount returns a disposer; call it when your host removes the interface.

sections.title: 05 — Make it yours
sections.body: Import a relative .css file from a component and assign static classes. CSS custom properties let you share a theme across your interface without changing component code.
sections.code:
import "./app.css"

component App:
    main class="app":
        h1 text="Hello, Qbits"
